bss.topic: Revisão do 1º período: eu, minha família e minha escola

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quem faz parte da nossa família?
options: as pessoas que cuidam de nós e vivem conosco
questions.answer: as pessoas que cuidam de nós e vivem conosco
questions.hint: Pense em quem mora com você.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que nos ajuda a saber quem somos?
questions.hint: Todo mundo tem um, e ele nos identifica.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Onde aprendemos com a professora e os colegas?
questions.hint: É o lugar das aulas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que devemos fazer quando um colega está falando?
questions.hint: Como você gosta que ouçam você?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual palavra mágica usamos para pedir algo?
questions.hint: É uma palavra educada para pedir.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Depois de receber ajuda, dizemos:
questions.hint: É uma forma de agradecer.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que fazemos com os brinquedos depois de brincar?
questions.hint: Assim a sala fica arrumada.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual atitude ajuda a turma a conviver bem?
questions.hint: Pense em ser gentil.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que dia comemoramos quantos anos temos?
questions.hint: Nesse dia tem bolo e velinhas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Todas as famílias são iguais?
options: não, cada família é de um jeito
sim, todas têm o mesmo número de pessoas
sim, todas moram na mesma casa
questions.answer: não, cada família é de um jeito
questions.hint: Pense nas famílias dos seus colegas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quem trabalha na escola ajudando as crianças?
questions.hint: Pense em quem você encontra na escola.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que fazemos antes de comer o lanche?
questions.hint: Isso tira a sujeira e os germes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Se um colega cair no pátio, o que é melhor fazer?
questions.hint: O que você gostaria que fizessem por você?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Para atravessar a rua, damos a mão para:
questions.hint: Quem cuida da nossa segurança?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Conte uma coisa de que você gosta de fazer com sua família.
questions.hint: Pense num passeio, num jogo ou numa refeição juntos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Diga uma regra da sua sala de aula e por que ela é importante.
questions.hint: Pense em fila, silêncio, ajuda ou cuidado com os materiais.

en.topic: Review: capital letters, full stops and recounts

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word should start with a capital letter?
questions.hint: Days of the week always start with a capital letter.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What goes at the end of a sentence?
questions.hint: It is a small dot.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What do we leave between words?
questions.hint: It helps us read each word.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word needs a capital letter in this sentence: "i like to play."?
questions.hint: When we write about ourselves, this word is always a capital.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write this name with a capital letter: "sam"
questions.hint: Names of people start with a big letter.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which one is a sentence?
questions.hint: A sentence makes sense on its own.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A recount tells us about…
questions.hint: It tells about the past.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word helps us put a recount in order?
questions.hint: It tells us what happened at the start.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word comes after "First" and "Next" in a recount?
questions.hint: It tells us what happened after.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is about the past?
options: Yesterday I went to the park.
Tomorrow I will go to the park.
questions.answer: Yesterday I went to the park.
questions.hint: Look for "yesterday".

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Pick the best last word for a recount: "___, we went home."
questions.hint: It shows the end.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Add the missing full stop and write the sentence: "We had fun"
questions.hint: Put a dot at the end.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write one sentence about something you did at the weekend. Use a capital letter and a full stop.
questions.hint: Start with "On Saturday I…" or "On Sunday I…".

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write two sentences about your day at school, using "First" and "Then".
questions.hint: What did you do at the start of the day? What came next?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is the name of a place, so it needs a capital letter?
questions.hint: A special name of a city starts with a big letter.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word should have a capital letter? "We went to the zoo on tuesday."
questions.hint: Days of the week are special names.

en_read.topic: Review: favourite stories and rhymes from Term 1

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What do we do when we retell a story?
options: tell what happened in our own words
questions.answer: tell what happened in our own words
questions.hint: Think about beginning, middle and end.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which part of a story comes first?
questions.hint: It is where the story starts.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which part of a story tells us how it finishes?
questions.hint: It is the last part.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which pair of words rhyme?
questions.hint: Rhyming words sound the same at the end.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word rhymes with "star"?
questions.hint: Say them aloud and listen to the end.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word rhymes with "bee"?
questions.hint: Listen for "-ee".

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word rhymes with "frog"?
questions.hint: Listen for "-og".

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Finish the rhyme with a word that rhymes with "dish": "I saw a big ___ swimming in the sea."
questions.hint: It lives in water and has fins.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Who are the characters in a story?
options: the people or animals in it
questions.answer: the people or animals in it
questions.hint: Think about who the story is about.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Where a story happens is called the…
questions.hint: It could be a forest, a castle or a house.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: The name of a book is its…
questions.hint: It is on the front cover.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: The person who writes a story is the…

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In a story, a little bear lost his red ball and then found it under his bed. What did the bear lose?
questions.hint: Read the sentence again.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In the same story, where did the bear find his ball?
questions.hint: Look for the place word.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which story from this term was your favourite? Say why you liked it.
questions.hint: Think about a character or a funny part.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Say a rhyme you know by heart, or make up two lines that rhyme.
questions.hint: You can use words like "cat" and "hat" or "sun" and "fun".

questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: _ _ink (to use your brain)

questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: _ _op (to cut wood)

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: r_ _n (water from the clouds)
questions.hint: The /ai/ sound is made with two letters.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: b_ _ (not a girl)

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which is the correct spelling?

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has the /ai/ sound?
questions.hint: Look for two vowels together.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has a double letter at the end?
questions.hint: Look for two letters that are the same.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has a split digraph?

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word starts with the /ch/ sound?

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: shel → shell; rane → rain; hoam → home; sed → said; caik → cake
questions.hint: Check the words with double letters, split digraphs and tricky words.
questions.text: Tom went to the beach with his mum. He found a big shel on the sand. Then it started to rane, so they ran hoam. Mum sed they could make a caik and have a cup of hot milk.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which is the correct spelling of the place where you live?
questions.hint: It has a split digraph: o-e.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Pick the correct spelling: "Mum ___ yes."
questions.hint: It is a tricky word: it does not look how it sounds.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Pick the correct spelling: "I can see ___ moon."
questions.hint: It starts with two letters that make one sound.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words in the story.
questions.answer: boi → boy; blak → black; thinc → think; chopp → chop; teh → the
questions.hint: Look carefully at the sounds ck, th, ch and oy.
questions.text: A little boi had a blak cat called Pip. One day Pip ran up a tree. The boy did not know what to do. He had to thinc hard. Then Dad came to chopp a branch, and teh cat jumped down safely.
